analogy.rationale: The vitamin B class targets biotin-dependent carboxylases (PC, PCCA/PCCB, MCCC1/2, ACACA/ACACB) and related cofactor enzymes, so its transcriptional signature is dominated by metabolic/cofactor stress rather than a canonical receptor program; the closest reference classes are other metabolic-enzyme inhibitors, but overlap is limited, so the expected response is weak.
